title: Rav Idit
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Sanhedrin 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.38b.19): a great man in the time of Rav Nachman, who used to argue with the heretics (minim). And Rav Nachman said of him: "Whoever knows how to answer the heretics like Rav Idit, let him answer; and if not, let him not answer." And the reading in Dikdukei Soferim and in [Yalkut, Mishpatim, remez 359](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Torah.359.8), is "Rav Idi."[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Idit, as does [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=412&lang=en) in his citation of Rav Nachman’s maxim. The linked Yalkut has Idi in the dialogue about Exodus 24:1. The Dikdukei Soferim reading is reported by Hyman.
